name: api
lk-note-no-test-target: Deliberate — see the Testing section in CLAUDE.md. Vitest fails inside Nx's run-commands spawn (Nx 23.1 ↔ Vitest 4, found in etx-working-time-manager), so a `test` target here would fail on every invocation. Tests run via `pnpm test` (root Vitest workspace) or `pnpm vitest run --project api`.
lk-note-no-prune-targets: `generatePackageJson: true` in webpack.config.js already writes dist/apps/api/package.json plus a pruned lockfile, and scripts/build/complete-api-package-json.mjs adds what webpack cannot see. apps/api deliberately has no package.json of its own.
lk-note-db-deploy-vs-migrate: db:deploy runs `prisma migrate deploy`: applies pending migrations, never prompts, never resets. It is what CI, container start and anything holding data run. db:migrate runs `prisma migrate dev`, which diffs schema.prisma against the history and writes a new migration (SQLite needs no shadow database URL; Prisma uses a temporary file). There is deliberately no db:push target. All db:* targets run from the repo root with --config: a relative DATABASE_URL (file:./.data/lazykoins.db) resolves against the working directory, and the app runs from the root too — see src/persistence/prisma/sqlite-url.ts.
